policy.authority: Unchanged questions and predetermined expected answers; source-reference appendix supersedes only historical approximate locators.
policy.material_parts: All actually requested material clauses, timing, costs, destinations, quantities, consequences and applicable exceptions required. Incidental key background and convenient layout not separately requested are not added as requirements.

grades.correct: All requested material parts supplied and no false gameplay ruling.
grades.partial: At least one requested material part missing or abstained, with no contradictory ruling.
grades.incorrect: A false ruling or contradiction, including a volunteered gameplay ruling.

policy.semantic_equivalence: Accept semantic equivalents and reasonable contextual wording; do not require verbatim phrasing.
policy.evidence: Assess support independently of reader labels. Same-question evidence can supply a missing fact or create a contradiction. A bare section citation supplies no fact. No cross-question borrowing.
policy.unsupported_guess: Separate boolean flag for source-correct claims absent from supplied summary; not inferred from poor phrasing. False claims are graded as contradictions, not flagged as source-correct unsupported guesses.
